title: Tamagoyaki (Japanese Rolled Omelette)
description: This Japanese rolled omelette recipe, called tamagoyaki, is seasoned with soy sauce, mirin, and dashi. Enjoy it as part of a meal or as an appetizer.

steps.text: Whisk eggs, dashi stock, sugar, mirin, and soy sauce together in a bowl.

Heat ⅓ oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add about ⅓ egg mixture; quickly swirl the pan to evenly cover the bottom. Start rolling up omelette from one side to the other as soon as it is set.

Keep roll to one side; add ⅓ more oil to the skillet and ⅓ more egg. Swirl the pan, ensuring entire bottom is covered, including around and underneath first roll; cook until set. Roll up omelette starting from side with first roll, and including first roll, so you end up with one roll.
Repeat process with remaining ⅓ each oil and egg and so you end up with one roll; transfer to a bamboo rolling mat. Roll up omelette tightly; cool about 3 minutes.
Unwrap omelette; slice into 6 pieces. Serve warm or cold.

video.description: It's easy to make authentic Japanese food at home with this classic Japanese omelette recipe. Tamagoyaki is slightly sweet and seasoned with soy sauce, mirin, and dashi stock. It's a favorite in bento boxes and also makes an easy Japanese appetizer. Serve with shredded daikon and soy sauce for dipping.
